id.title: Kalkulator subnet · Tools SagalaIT
id.lead: Hitung jaringan IPv4 dari CIDR atau IP dan netmask, bagi jadi subnet, periksa apakah IP ada di jaringan, dan ringkas daftar CIDR. Semua di browser.
id.e_octal: Angka berawalan nol (mis. 010) ditolak karena bisa terbaca sebagai oktal. Tulis tanpa nol di depan.
id.e_prefix: Panjang prefiks harus 0 sampai 32, atau netmask yang valid.
id.e_mask: Netmask tidak kontigu. Netmask yang valid berbentuk bit 1 lalu bit 0, misalnya 255.255.255.0.
id.not_net: {ip} bukan alamat jaringan. Jaringan sebenarnya adalah {net}/{p}.
id.p31: /31 memakai 2 host tanpa alamat jaringan dan broadcast (RFC 3021).
id.bin_legend: Bit jaringan tebal dan bergaris bawah; bit host tipis.
id.count_note: Dibulatkan ke pangkat dua: {n} subnet berprefiks /{p}.
id.too_many: Jumlah subnet terlalu besar untuk jaringan ini.
id.chk_ip: Apakah IP ada di jaringan di atas?
id.rel_same: A dan B adalah jaringan yang sama.
id.rel_disjoint: A dan B terpisah, tidak tumpang tindih.
id.empty: Ketik alamat untuk melihat hasilnya, atau pakai contoh.

en.title: Subnet calculator · Tools SagalaIT
en.lead: Work out an IPv4 network from CIDR or IP and netmask, split it into subnets, check whether an IP is in a network, and summarize a list of CIDRs. All in your browser.
en.e_octet: Each part of the address must be 0 to 255.
en.e_octal: Numbers with a leading zero (e.g. 010) are rejected because they can be read as octal. Write them without the leading zero.
en.e_prefix: The prefix length must be 0 to 32, or a valid netmask.
en.e_mask: The netmask is not contiguous. A valid netmask is 1 bits followed by 0 bits, for example 255.255.255.0.
en.not_net: {ip} is not a network address. The actual network is {net}/{p}.
en.p31: /31 uses 2 hosts with no network or broadcast address (RFC 3021).
en.bin_legend: Network bits are bold and underlined; host bits are light.
en.count_note: Rounded up to a power of two: {n} subnets with prefix /{p}.
en.too_many: That many subnets do not fit in this network.
en.chk_ip: Is this IP inside the network above?
en.rel_same: A and B are the same network.
en.rel_disjoint: A and B are separate and do not overlap.
en.empty: Type an address to see the result, or use an example.
